messages:
sarah: Hey team — customer Horizon Apps (acct: horizon-42) flagged a month-end mismatch. Their dashboard CSV shows 1,239,512 tokens for Feb but the invoice line totals 1,118,203. Customer wants a reason before their accounting close. Can billing triage?
eli: Thanks Sarah. Can you drop the account export and the exact CSV they pulled? Also which timezone they expect the cutoff in?
sarah: Pasted CSV to Google Drive: https://redwood.internal/gdrive/horizon-42/eom-csv (internal). They say they use local timezone PST for internal reporting but expect invoice in UTC.
maria: Noted. Initial hypothesis: cutoff window shift put ~120k tokens into next billing period. Billing run log shows invoice job used cutoff 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z. Need to compare token events around 2026-02-28T23:00:00Z-2026-03-01T01:00:00Z.
billing-bot: invoice-run: horizon-42 processed. invoice_id=inv_2026_02_horizon42 total_tokens=1118203 compute_time=00:02:44 cutoff_ts=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z meter_version=v3.4.1
ryan: I pulled token-meter events for horizon-42. Quick grep shows a spike between 2026-02-28T23:30:00Z and 2026-03-01T00:45:00Z. Attaching short SQL used to aggregate:```sql
SELECT date_trunc('minute', event_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as minute, sum(tokens)
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = 'horizon-42'
  AND event_time >= '2026-02-28'
  AND event_time < '2026-03-02'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;```
sarah: The customer's dashboard is flattening times to PST and then truncating to day, so their Feb 28 PST (which includes UTC Mar 1 07:00) shows more tokens in Feb on their side. But they exported "billing period: Feb" from dashboard UI which used their org TZ setting (PST).
eli: So two different cutoffs: our invoice cut at 00:00 UTC, their dashboard cut at 00:00 PST. That could explain ~120k tokens. Can we quantify how many tokens fall into the UTC day split?
ryan: I ran the delta quickly: tokens with event_time >= '2026-03-01T00:00:00Z' and < '2026-03-01T02:00:00Z' = 121,309 tokens. Those are counted on the customer's Feb 28 PST export but on our Mar 1 invoice.
maria: OK — that's the primary cause. Additional small delta: there was a promotional credit applied on Mar 1 00:10Z which reduced invoice charges; customer saw gross tokens on dashboard (no credits) but invoice shows net after credit. That accounts for an extra ~4,000 token-equivalent credit.
finance-liaison: For next steps finance will: 1) offer a one-time invoice adjustment or credit if customer wants Feb to match their dashboard; 2) document timezone behavior in customer-facing billing docs. Which does the customer prefer?
sarah: Customer asked for a corrected Feb invoice showing dashboard-aligned totals. They want a line-level reconciliation to send to their accounting team. They asked if we can issue a corrected invoice or provide a reconciliation CSV showing UTC vs PST allocation.
maria: We can produce a reconciliation CSV (UTC tokens, PST tokens, credits applied) and also create a corrected invoice (adj_credit) if they confirm. Finance, please confirm any tax/ledger implications.
finance-liaison: Confirmed. If they want invoice reissue we need signed approval from the customer. I'll prepare an adj invoice workflow and a reconciliation export.
eli: Internal action items: - ryan to drop reconciliation CSV into secure bucket (include minute-level allocation) - maria to draft support message explaining cutoff mismatch + credit explanation - finance-liaison to prepare adj invoice workflow and confirm ledger steps.
ryan: CSV will be here in ~30m: s3://billing-exports/horizon-42/eom-recon-2026-02.csv (internal). It includes columns: event_time_utc, tokens, event_time_pst, bucketed_day_pst.
sarah: I sent the customer the expected explanation and asked if they want an adjustment. They replied "Yes please, we prefer the invoice to match the dashboard for internal reporting."
maria: OK, please escalate to account exec for signed confirmation. I'll queue the adj_invoice once signed.
billing-bot: adj-invoice-request created ticket=billing/adj/2026-03-0007 status=pending_approval
sarah: Thanks everyone. Closing the loop: root cause = timezone cutoff mismatch + a small promo credit timing. Action: reconciliation CSV + adj invoice pending signed approval. I'll post the final note when adj invoice is issued. :thumbsup:
